entries.displayName: Acrobat
entries.description: A second jump in mid-air is no longer a problem for you.

entries.displayName: A bank robbery with a single pinky finger.
Bare-Knuckle Master
entries.description: Your punches have a chance to knock enemies out.

entries.displayName: Theft of two cans of beer from the 69th floor store.
Numerous body jams in the passages of the Residential Block.
entries.description: Boxes collapse under the onslaught of your body, and enemies literally fly away from your attacks. However, there is no way for you to enter the narrow gaps anymore.

entries.displayName: Born Lucky
entries.description: You are like a walking four-leaf clover. You are lucky in everything you do.

entries.displayName: Illegal collection and sale of glass bottles to foreign investors.
entries.description: You’ve gotten so good at collecting glass bottles that now they practically fly doubled into your pockets. Only with a slight chance, to be honest.

entries.displayName: Bullseye
entries.description: Years of training have sharpened your aim, letting you deal increased damage to enemies.

entries.displayName: Gnawed a cellmate to their core.
entries.description: Health is replenished by eating any meat.

entries.displayName: Ate monthly supply of protein bars.
Leaving a fellow party member to be eaten by a concrete devourer.
Self-immolation using AI-80 gasoline.
Especially petty fraud.
Clandestine blacksmithing business.
entries.description: Any items in your hands spend {0}% less durability.

entries.displayName: Grade-52 Technician
entries.description: Your training in the local restroom taught you to quickly handle disarming, repairing, and lockpicking.

entries.displayName: Healthy Lifestyle
entries.description: Morning exercises have significantly boosted your overall health.

entries.displayName: Heavy Lifter
entries.description: You can sprint at full carry weight with normal speed — at the cost of your health.

entries.displayName: Infection of a fellow party with coils (3rd degree).
Iron Immunity
entries.description: Your immune system blocks various types of damage.

entries.displayName: Killing a priest from the 451th floor.
Consuming high-octane beverages in front of a minor audience.
entries.description: Your stomach digests gasoline like its water… even better! Drinking gasoline heals you!

entries.displayName: Illegal appropriation of two identical spice packets found in the same package of instant noodles.
Physical Therapy
entries.description: Regular trips to the doctors have left a mark on your health: now it is slowly but surely regenerating.

entries.displayName: The poisoning of a co-partner by his own gas. Diagnosis: incurable.
entries.description: You have a serious stomach problem, expressed by a loud, attention-grabbing sound. Nevertheless, it gives you speed for a while.

entries.displayName: Participation in a cult with one successful resurrection of a dead man.
entries.description: You have been given {0} extra life.

entries.displayName: Regular sessions of jumping around the abandoned premises of the Gigastructure.
entries.description: You jump {0}% more powerfully.

entries.displayName: Perfectionist
entries.description: Careful item handling is your philosophy — everything you touch degrades much slower.

entries.displayName: Night Shift
entries.description: Professional negligence: abandoning a guard post during the night shift; theft of gummy concentrates from closed retail outlets; feeding local vermin (rats).

entries.displayName: Escaping from a mental hospital while under the influence of sedatives.
entries.description: Sometimes you see objects through walls. But sometimes the world descends into utter darkness.

entries.displayName: Arson of a manure warehouse on the 2555th floor.
Throwing feces in the party council room on the 42nd floor.
A sham marriage to a member of the feuding Cappulet clan.
Murder during a fight. The opponent died from 33 fractures after being hit on the legs of a prisoner.
entries.description: Your legs are strong. Even an explosive wave won't be able to throw you off balance.

entries.displayName: Elevator shaft attack.
Torture of a cellmate with a wrench.
